# Superintendent Bell

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Superintendent Bell is characterized by his gray whiskers and glasses.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Superintendent Bell is described as a truly virtuous man.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P10](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0010)_

## Traits

- virtuous  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P10](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0010)</sub>

## History

Superintendent Bell was among the local figures who visited [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) while she was bedridden for seven weeks. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was recovering at home under the care of [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) after breaking her ankle in a fall from a roof ridgepole during a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
